name: Padang Sidempuan
routes: See city-2652-padang-sidempuan.json attemptsRecorded; all executed first-party discovery, viewer/configuration, and bounded request attempts are recorded there with outcomes and URLs.
queryAndRequestOutcome: English and Indonesian discovery found the local Kantor Pertanahan Kota Padangsidimpuan/BPN custodian and the national ATR/BPN BHUMI viewer. BHUMI configuration exposed a Bidang Tanah layer and tokenized parcel retrieval flow, but direct public WMS/WFS probes failed and no safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-polygon response was obtained. The city ArcGIS page is an administrative slum-profile map, not a cadastre.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: BHUMI: Geoserver-style /bhumigs/umum, layer umum:Persil. City web map: ArcGIS Web Mercator administrative layers.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Parcel CRS not observed; city map EPSG:3857 is not parcel evidence.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: No safe native parcel identity observed in a feature response; NIB is only described in BHUMI viewer text/configuration.

sourceFieldMapping.BHUMI: Configured layer umum:Persil; described fields include NIB and area.
sourceFieldMapping.cityArcGIS: Administrative fields only; not treated as parcel fields.
